strings.en: No need for tactics against lower life forms!
Die for the Dirad!
Everything exists for our sake!
Suffer! Suffer!
I'll shatter that so-called pride of yours!
Now vanish!
Don't underestimate the life force of us plants!
You will become our blood and flesh!
You'll become a people robbed of their world by us!
Consider this your invitation to Hell!
Curse your own lack of strength!
Die and become food for the Dirad!!
Gyaaaaah!
H-how could we plants...
Fearsome! Truly fearsome!
Wh-who knew you were this strong!
D-damn you! At this rate...!?
We cannot afford to lose!!
Nothing to fear!
Not yet! Not yet!
I won't fall to the likes of you!
What feeble creatures!
Hahaha! What kind of attack was that!
Is that all you've got!?
Hahaha! What kind of attack was that!
You didn't really think you could win, did you?
Were you actually trying to hit me!?
Do you still not see that you're no match for us!?
...What!? What is this energy!
What am I lacking!?
Cheap tricks!
Fool! You're within range!!
I'll shoot you down with my own hands!
This ends it! Die for the sake of us Dirad!
You won't stand in the way of our long-held dream!
In the end, you're no match for the life force of us plants!
You think you can defeat us with that little power!?
